thread:
maya_support: TenantX (CASE-9876) reports a big p99 jump after last night's deploy — p99 ~120ms -> ~900ms and a few 504s. They say dashboard shows the spike but the histogram panel looks flat. Can someone take?
ethan_oncall: on it. Any traces or a repro request from the customer?
tenantx_support: They attached a trace id: trace-7f3a. Repro steps: hitting /v1/generate with a ~1.2k token prompt. Happens intermittently, ~1/20 requests.
lina_sre: likely sampling/rollup mismatch but also could be late-arriving spans. Quick check: is the p99 panel using rollup quantiles vs raw histogram?
oliver_obs: Confirmed — p99 panel = rollup-based quantile over 5m windows. Histogram is raw bucketized ingestion. If events arrive late they won't match. Link: https://dash.redwood/tenantx/latency (screenshot attached).
maya_support: here's an example curl the customer ran: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -o /dev/null -w '%{time_total} %{http_code}\n'``` got `0.92 200` then `1.03 504` in same session.
incidents_bot: deploy_bot: Canary deploy r-2026.03.16-12:03 completed across zone-a -> zone-b at 2026-03-16T12:03:22Z.
lina_sre: can we run this raw distribution query for the tenant for the 2h window around the deploy (include event_time vs ingest_time)? ```SELECT histogram_quantile(0.99, histogram_merge(latency_hist)) FROM traces WHERE tenant='tenantx' AND event_time >= now()-2h```
oliver_obs: running now — preliminary: rollup p99 shows spike at 12:10, raw histogram shows a shoulder but many late events with ingest_time > event_time+30s. Looks like some spans were delayed (proxy retries).
ethan_oncall: actionables: 1) quick mitigation: increase auth-proxy concurrency from 200->350 for tenantx in zone-b, 2) enable model-fallback (lower-capacity variant) for requests >800ms, 3) add dashboard annotation for the deploy. Who can push the proxy config?
maya_support: I'll coordinate with infra to bump proxy concurrency and inform TenantX.
lina_sre: I'll instrument a short-lived panel that shows ingest_delay distribution and add a filter on retry_count. If retries correlate with tail, we have our culprit.
oliver_obs: did the proxy bump — rolling now. Also toggled model-fallback flag to ON for tenantx-canary. Monitoring ingress.
ethan_oncall: seeing initial improvement on synthetic traffic — p95 from 180ms -> 95ms, p99 from 920ms -> ~250ms. Still watching.
tenantx_support: TenantX confirms fewer 504s in last 10 mins. Thanks.
lina_sre: follow-up: need root cause — why did spans get delayed? Hypothesis: upstream auth service had a short GC/queue that caused retries and late ingests. Will open an RCA ticket and link traces.
maya_support: created CASE-9876-FOLLOWUP and added deploy + annotation. We should also add a note to docs about rollup vs histogram differences for support.
ethan_oncall: agreed. For now: mark incident as mitigated, keep watch for 2h then close. I'll also add a short blameless postmortem draft. :thumbsup:
oliver_obs: saved queries and added ingest_delay panel to tenantx dashboard.
lina_sre: moving to follow-up. Thanks team. :coffee:
